title: Auditing the Unauditable: analysis code for the SHAP-based EU AI Act compliance assessment on COMPAS
description: Reproduction code for the article 'Auditing the Unauditable: SHAP-Based EU AI Act Compliance Assessment and the Limits of Correlation-Based De-Biasing in Recidivism Prediction'. Eleven numbered Python scripts reproduce every table and figure of the manuscript from the public ProPublica COMPAS file.
